steps.title: Kill one of the four to call a lesser spirit
steps.zone: Ocean of Tears · Rathe Mountains · Butcherblock Mountains · Field of Bone
steps.note: A lesser spirit appears where it dies. Do not kill the spirit.

steps.title: Tell the lesser spirit you wish to know more
Hand Bondl Felligan the Tiny Gem
steps.note: He leads you to the Jade Tiger, where the greater spirits appear.

steps.title: Question the greater spirit of your god until it gives the Opaque Gem
steps.caution: Say "I will walk the path of the Heyokah" only once you hold the gem — the spirit leaves at once.

steps.title: Hand Ooglyn the Opaque Gem
steps.note: Her spawn takes two hours.

steps.title: Hear out the drowned, then ask the greater spirit for the next path
steps.note: Only one shaman can take the test at a time.

steps.title: Hand a wandering spirit the Small Gem
steps.note: It looks like a brighter wisp and roams between Qeynos Hills and the bandit camp.

steps.title: Kill Glaron the Wicked and Tabien the Goodly
Hand the wandering spirit Envy, Woe and Marr's Promise
steps.note: Ask "What shield of falsehood?" and "What last path?".

steps.title: Hand the Spirit Sentinel the Sparkling Gem
Kill Black Dire for his pelt

steps.title: Hand the Spirit Sentinel the Black Dire Pelt
steps.note: He also hands you a six-slot booklet.

steps.title: Loot the six reports in the City of Mist

steps.title: Combine the six reports in the booklet
Hand the Spirit Sentinel the completed report
Kill Lord Ghiosk and loot his three books

steps.title: Hand the three books to the Spirit Sentinel in the pond
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk
steps.caution: Not the Spirit Sentinel near the City of Mist — the one in the pond.

steps.title: Pick up the Icon of the High Scale
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk

steps.title: Hand High Scale Kirn the icon
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk

steps.title: Kill High Scale Kirn and loot his ring

steps.title: Hand Neh`Ashiir the ring
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk

steps.title: Kill Neh`Ashiir and loot her diary
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk

steps.title: Hand the Spirit Sentinel the diary
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk

steps.title: Kill the Iksar Broodling for a Child's Tear

steps.title: Hand Lord Rak`Ashiir the Child's Tear

steps.title: Kill Lord Rak`Ashiir for his Iksar Scale
